title: An agent gets its own identity
goal: {{cast.operator}} wants {{cast.agent}} to call tools, and wants to know afterwards who was accountable.
obstacle: A shared API key says nothing about who owns it, what it may reach or when it should stop working.
control: {{cast.key}} is the agent's whole identity. It names {{cast.custodian}}, carries scopes and limits, and expires.

steps.title: Pick the custodian
steps.tell: {{cast.operator}} registers {{cast.agent}} and names {{cast.custodian}} as the human it acts as.
steps.say: Policy is issued to the custodian, and the gateway log names them. If they go inactive, the key stops working, so pick someone who will stay.

steps.title: Select the apps
steps.say: Selecting the app is the grant. Privilege creates the policy tied to this key; nothing else needs writing.

steps.title: Set scopes and limits
steps.tell: {{cast.operator}} gives {{cast.key}} only the scopes {{cast.agent}} uses, plus rate, budget and expiry limits.
steps.say: A key with all three scopes is one secret that reaches models, tools and agents. Give only what the agent uses.
